instruction: Find Portal 2 game and add it to the shopping cart.

metadata.explanation: Task variation: User searches for Portal 2 and adds it to cart. Evaluator verifies 'Portal 2' appears in cart page. Same interaction pattern as original task with different game. Uses standard Chrome page_info getter and is_added_to_steam_cart metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Instruction requires adding 'Portal 2 game' to cart, evaluator checks if 'Portal 2' appears in cart page HTML content - fully covers the requirement
Correct state extraction: Getter get_page_info navigates to cart URL (https://store.steampowered.com/cart/) and extracts full HTML content, which is the correct state to verify cart contents

Correct comparison logic: Metric is_added_to_steam_cart performs simple string containment check (item in content), which is semantically correct for verifying if an item name appears in the cart page
Correct expected value: Expected rules contain ['Portal 2'] which exactly matches the instruction requirement to add 'Portal 2 game' to cart
Runtime feasibility: The logic will work correctly at runtime - navigating to cart page and checking HTML content for item name is a reliable verification method
